messages:
anya: Throwing this here — saw a 1.8x 95th-pct latency jump on opt-2 when seq=2048 after the kernel-routing flag rolled at 2765120001. Baseline ~28ms -> ~50ms observed on p4d-eu.
rhea: same here. avg is fine, tail only. looks like the selector picked a different kernel for larger batches.
sanjay: can you paste the selector debug line + a quick pprof/flame? suspect fused_paged_v3 fallback.
anya: selector log: "route=auto kernel=fused_paged_v3 model=opt-2 seq=2048 batch=12 reason=latency_policy". quick flame dump from perf-agent: 
```text
0.00  batch_collate
0.02  kv/prefetch
0.06  fused_paged_v3::launch
0.90  cuda_sync
```
marta: that cuda_sync spike is huge. fused_paged_v3 may be introducing a blocking sync when KV misses happen or when merging KV prefixes.
perf-bot: deploy 2765120001 by infra/main: rollout complete :white_check_mark:
anya: repro command I used: 
```bash
python tools/bench.py --model opt-2 --seq 2048 --batch 12 --qps 40 --duration 60
```
sanjay: forced FORCE_KERNEL=flash_paged locally and tail dropped back to ~30ms (near baseline). so the path choice is the variable here.
rhea: suggestion: run with NVTX markers + nsys capture to confirm if fused_paged_v3 does an implicit stream sync or device-to-host hop. also try nvprof to catch hidden syncs.
liam: I reproduced an intermittent OOM when fused_paged_v3 + batch>=14 + kv_prefetch_disabled. memory footprint in fused_paged_v3 looks like it grows nonlinearly with batch.
marta: short-term workaround: override selector with KERNEL_FALLBACK_ORDER=flash_paged,flash,fused and set max_batch_for_fused=8 in canary; reduces tail and avoids OOM.
sanjay: we'll also bisect the selector heuristic change. maybe someone adjusted the batch threshold in the routing rule.
anya: starting bisect across infra/selector between commit c8d9f2 (rollout) and b3a7f5e (previous). will post the commit that flipped default thresholds.
liam: add to repro: run with CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to make ordering bugs surface; use `python tools/bench.py --capture nsys` for traces.
marta: filing PERF-4589 with repro steps, traces, nvprof tips, and a link to canary logs. tagging runtime/attn, infra/selector, and eng-sre.
anya: summary: regression correlated with kernel-route rollout -> fused_paged_v3 chosen for larger batches -> introduces cuda_sync and memory growth -> tail latency increase and sporadic OOMs. workaround applied to canary. follow-up: bisect selector, instrument fused_paged_v3 for hidden syncs, audit mem allocation strategy.
